# ferriskey_authz_state (Resource)

Enables or disables Cedar authorization for a FerrisKey realm (singleton per realm). Destroying the resource sets `enabled` back to `false`, the default state of a realm. The API requires the server to run with `AUTHZ_ENABLED=true`; otherwise every authorization endpoint answers 404.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_authz_state" "main" {
  realm   = "acme"
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the realm answers authorization questions.
- `realm` (String) Realm whose authorization state is managed. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier (equal to `realm`).
- `version` (Number) Counter the server increments every time the realm's authorization rules change.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ferriskey_authz_state.main acme
```
